skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 900% ATK DMG. Each strike has a 50% chance to add 1 stack of [Specialized Burn]. Has a 100% chance to reduce the entire enemy team’s Crit Rate by 40% for 2 rounds. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 300% ATK as DoT DMG. Disappears after triggering 3 times. After any character acts, transfers to a target that can receive DMG.

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks enemies in a row with 3 consecutive strikes, dealing 1200% ATK DMG. Each strike has an 80% chance to add 1 stack of [Specialized Burn]. Has a 100% chance to reduce the entire enemy team’s Crit Rate by 60% for 2 rounds. [Specialized Burn]: Deals 400% ATK as DoT DMG. Disappears after triggering 3 times. After any character acts, transfers to a target that can receive DMG.

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, has a 100% chance to reduce the enemy team’s Heal Rate by 60%. At battle start, gains a 60% chance of [Evasion]. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG.

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, has a 100% chance to reduce the enemy team’s Heal Rate by 70%. At battle start, gains a 70% chance of [Evasion]. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG.

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, has a 100% chance to reduce the enemy team’s Heal Rate by 80%. At battle start, gains an 80% chance of [Evasion]. [Evasion]: Reduces Direct DMG, Extra DMG, Charge DMG, and Berserk DMG received to 1 DMG.

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: All allies permanently gain 60% [Buffer]. After any character acts, removes [Stun] or [Specialized Stun] from 1 ally. Each debuff can be removed up to 3 times per round. [Buffer]: Reduces DMG based on Max HP.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: All allies permanently gain 80% [Buffer]. After any character acts, removes [Stun] or [Specialized Stun] from 1 ally. Each debuff can be removed an unlimited number of times per round. [Buffer]: Reduces DMG based on Max HP.

effects.desc: The dodge status reduces Direct, Bonus, Charged, and Fury damage taken to just 1 point for the duration.
Burning PvP tier — stronger burst damage, harder to deal with.
